text: Ship's chandler! Shot, canvas, plating, rope. Everything a hull needs.
{npc}. If your ship's hurting, I've the cure.
Chain shot for the sails, grapeshot for the crew, round shot for everything else.
Keep your voice down. There are marines about, and your face is on the posters.
I'll serve you, but quickly. Bounty hunters drink in here.
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Wretched rain. Gets into everything.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Late to be wandering about.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Can't sleep either, eh?
Up with the gulls, I see.
Early start, {player}.
Mist'll burn off by mid-morning.
Round shot breaks hulls. Chain shot tears sails, slows them right down. Grapeshot clears decks.
Explosive shells, if you can afford them, do all three, loudly.
Right-click your own ship with them. Hull plating, gun carriages, fine canvas, cargo bulkheads. And swivel guns, for the rail.
